title: LLM-Assisted Content Conditional Debiasing for Fair Text Embedding
reasoning: The paper focuses primarily on gender debiasing in text embeddings. While it acknowledges religion as a domain of bias in its introduction and utilizes general fairness benchmarks that occasionally include religious subsets, its specific experimental evaluation and the proposed benchmark (CCED) are demonstrated and measured using gender-based datasets. It does not contain a dedicated component for evaluating or benchmarking religion, spiritual traditions, or specific moral/ethical systems.
